items.reason: Existing FGAP V2 realms can lack the newly added Groups resource: the base schema contains only Users and Clients, and server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java:250 returns without updating an existing permissions client. The lookup at AdminPermissionsSchema.java:150 can therefore return null. The new services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java:147 passes that null to findByResource, which dereferences it at model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/authorization/StoreFactoryCacheSession.java:938, causing an exception instead of permission denial.
